## Kind of proposal

- [ ] An experiment that would test an existing hypothesis
- [ ] A reason an existing hypothesis is wrong
- [ ] Prior art we missed (see `docs/research/related_work.md` §7 for open searches)
- [ ] A confound or threat to validity in `docs/research/methodology.md`
- [ ] A new hypothesis

## What would falsify it?

<!-- Required. A claim with no falsifying observation is not a research proposal.
     If the answer is "nothing", say so — that is itself useful information. -->

## Prior art

<!-- If you are reporting prior art, please give a primary source: DOI, arXiv id,
